caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a single ceramic vessel placed centrally within a bordered rectangular area on a beige page. The vessel is round with a wide body, a narrow base, and an outwardly flared rim. The body of the vessel is rendered in a light beige or tan color to suggest clay, with blue decorative designs painted onto its surface. The blue decorations include abstract shapes as well as a side profile of a human face, a bird on the cheek, geometric shapes, and a solid blue shape near the base. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset detail of a section of the vessel; this closeup also features blue decorative elements in a more abstract, possibly foliate or ribbon-like form. The artist’s name, “JANET RIZA,” is typed in the lower right portion of the main bordered area. Handwritten notes and numbers are lightly visible near the inset.
title: Miniature Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
